title: Holder library follow-ups: confirm the flare envelope against a measured holder, re-seed the projection, no silent ER fallback

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Follow-ups from the high-tier review of PR #805 (#792), building on PR #800 (#793).

1. **The flare envelope only covers abrupt flares.** The body-to-flange envelope is a 45° cone ending at the flange front. It covers real flares at least that abrupt. A *gentler* flare (e.g. 1 radial mm per 2-3 axial mm) stands outside the cone near its foot, and the band reading only partly offsets that.
   - Fix the wording in `docs/decisions/792-er-collets.md`: it currently says "no steeper than 45 degrees" and should say "no more gradual than 45°".
   - **Decide the envelope after the user's hand measurement** of their BT30 ER20 holder. If a real flare is gentler, widen the envelope (a shallower cone, or a full-flange cylinder down to the nut top), so the model never under-reports the steel.
2. **The projection can go stale:** the picker seeds it at pick time (`crates/ui/src/state_tool_profile.rs:186-192`). If the tool's lengths are then edited and applied before "Apply holder", the holder lands higher than the steel. Re-seed it on a tool change, or flag the mismatch.
3. In `holder_library.rs:310-312`, the `sizes` closure's `unwrap_or(0)` silently falls back to ER11 for an unknown size name. Return a named error instead, and add an entry-count-per-taper test.

Effort: high (holder geometry feeds the collision checks).

**Done means:**
- The decision wording is corrected.
- The envelope is confirmed or widened from the measured holder.
- The projection re-seeds.
- No silent fallback remains.
- Each item is pinned.

Part of #743.
